title: Follow-up: parseDiff misreads -- / ++ content lines as headers and trims path whitespace
description: Nit 4 of the DEC-183 APPROVE review of opum-ai/glyph-cli#62 (GCLI-14), recorded verbatim on GCLI-14. Pre-existing and not introduced by #62: src/git.ts:244/248/249. With -U0, a removed content line beginning '-- ' or an added one beginning '++ ' renders as '--- '/'+++ ' and parseDiff reads it as a file header, starting a bogus FileChange. Separately, .trim() drops real trailing whitespace from an unquoted filename because git does not quote spaces. Fix by anchoring the header parse to the diff --git block (a pending 'diff --git' line) or by reading ordinal prefixes, and stop trimming path content.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A removed content line beginning '-- ' and an added content line beginning '++ ' are not parsed as '--- '/'+++ ' file headers.
A path with trailing whitespace is returned intact rather than trimmed away.
Existing diff answers are unchanged and bun run check passes.
